title: Carry on a pharmacy business only at registered premises
what: Own or hold a proprietary interest in a pharmacy business only if it is carried on at premises registered as a pharmacy.

sources.title: Pharmacy Act 2010 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not own, or hold a proprietary interest in, a pharmacy business unless the business is carried on at premises that are registered as a pharmacy.
